name: Steel and Wire Products Co.
old_description: Steel and Wire Products was founded by Conrad Buedel in 1929 in downtown Baltimore. The focus was hand drive nails sold directly to the contractor. Much of Baltimore was built with nails from Steel and Wire. Conrad's son, J. Conrad Buedel started at Steel and Wire in 1956 and ultimately moved the company to a larger facility outside the city in the early 1970s. As the company grew customers enjoyed good service and looked to buy additional items. During the same time period, Steel and Wire shifted their sales focus to selling retail lumberyards and building supply houses. The company quickly expanded into screws and then collated nails. Always keeping their focus on Quality - Progress -Service. Major brands started to notice the value Steel and Wire delivered and looked to them to distribute their products. Today we are a major distributor of leading brands of metal connectors, fasteners, caulks, sealants, adhesives and poly. In the late 1970s Mark, J. Conrad's son started his career at Steel and Wire and today is the president. In 2009 Mark hired his son Reid and then a few years later hired his other son Scott to continue the tradition to 100 years and beyond!
about:
Steel and Wire Products Co. was founded in 1929 by Conrad Buedel in downtown Baltimore, Maryland. The family-owned business began by selling hand-drive nails directly to contractors, supplying much of the city's early construction. Conrad's son, J. Conrad Buedel, joined in 1956 and relocated the company to a larger facility outside the city in the early 1970s. A third generation entered in the late 1970s when Mark Buedel started his career; he now serves as president, joined by his sons Reid and Scott in 2009 and later, continuing the family legacy.

Today the company operates as a wholesale distributor from two distribution centers — a Maryland facility at 6901 Quad Avenue in Baltimore (Rosedale) and a Connecticut warehouse in Dayville. The product line has expanded from nails to include screws, collated nails, metal connectors, caulks, sealants, adhesives, and polyethylene sheeting. Steel and Wire also develops its own Bullseye® brand of fasteners. The sales organization comprises more than 25 field representatives and 10 inside salespeople, supported by a workforce that includes employees with tenures of 10 to 40 years.

The distributor serves retail lumberyards, building-supply houses, and professional contractors across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, with market reach extending west and south. Customers include residential and commercial builders, carpenters, and specialty trade contractors who rely on the company's broad inventory of branded and private-label fastening and sealing products.

Steel and Wire emphasizes a "Quality – Progress – Service" philosophy inherited from its founding. The company states its differentiation lies in earning dealer loyalty by being the best option for all products carried, combining multi-location stock availability with deep product knowledge and long-term customer relationships.
